question: Three agricultural fields have surface reflectance measurements in the same units: field A: red=0.12, near-infrared=0.48; field B: red=0.18, near-infrared=0.42; field C: red=0.10, near-infrared=0.50. Use the available tools to compute NDVI for each field and the arithmetic mean of the three NDVI values. Use unrounded values for the mean and report all results to six decimal places.
